items.stem: Which TWO statements about the particle le are correct?

options.text: It can mark the completion of an action
options.rationale: Correct: le commonly marks a completed/realized action.

options.text: It can mark a change of state
options.rationale: Correct: sentence-final le often signals a change of state.

options.text: It is a measure word used to count people
options.rationale: Measure words such as ge/wei count people, not le.
Mandarin does not pluralize nouns with le.

options.text: It is the standard yes/no question particle
options.rationale: The yes/no question particle is ma, not le.

items.explanation: Correct keys: A, B. Correct: le commonly marks a completed/realized action. Correct: sentence-final le often signals a change of state.
